title: Quick-Fix Syrian Duck Fry
description: A yeasty, springy, and easy-to-make Syrian dish featuring duck sauce. This quick recipe is perfect for a low-fat-friendly option for lunch or dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the warm water and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add the sugar, salt, and 1 cup of flour to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add the remaining flour, 1/2 cup at a time, until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes pliable and slightly sticky.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Dust the dough with flour and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
Fry the dough pieces in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fried dough on paper towels.
In a separate pan, heat the duck sauce over medium heat.
Add the diced onion, bell pepper, and crushed garlic to the sauce. Cook until the vegetables are softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the fried dough hot with the duck sauce mixture spooned over the top.
